evidence.summary: SIA, founded in 1958, describes itself as a state-run research institution of the Chinese Academy of Sciences; its own history says the 15th Research Academy of China’s National Defence Science and Technology Commission managed its work from 1968 to 1970, after which it returned to the academy.
